name: Kim Withers
residence: Eastern Laramie County (she wrote that she had lived there more than 40 years and in Wyoming 42 years; 2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
occupation: Former CEO of Meridian Trust (32 years); she also wrote that she and her husband have owned businesses including a tree and drip-irrigation business and real estate (2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
education: Bachelor's degree in business administration and a master of science in human resources (institutions not named in the 2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
background: In her 2024 WyoFile questionnaire, Kim Withers wrote that she had lived in eastern Laramie County more than 40 years and in Wyoming 42 years, was born in El Paso, Texas, in an Army family, and would be 64 on Election Day 2024.

She wrote that she served as CEO of Meridian Trust for 32 years and that the credit union had 11 branches, nine in Wyoming. She said she and her husband have owned several businesses, from a tree and drip-irrigation business to real estate, and that she has a bachelor's degree in business administration and a master of science in human resources. She also wrote that she has been involved in Friday Food Bag, Rotary, the Cheyenne Frontier Days Old West Museum, and the Cheyenne-Laramie County Joint Powers Board.
